``` python
def my_function(
    param_1: float,
    param_2: float,
) -> float:
    """
    One-line summary.

    Parameters
    ----------
    param_1 : float
        Description. Units.
    param_2 : float
        Description. Units.

    Returns
    -------
    float
        Description. Units. Range.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> my_function(1.0, 2.0)

    """

```

## Step 8 — Tests

> All test cells must be marked `#| hide`. They run during `nbdev-test`
> but are excluded from generated documentation.
>
> Requirements: - Every exported function must have at least one test -
> Test edge cases: zero, negative, boundary values - Validate against
> known analytical results where possible - Each assert must have a
> descriptive failure message

``` python
#| hide
import numpy as np

# ── Test: my_function ────────────────────────────────────────────────
result = my_function(1.0, 2.0)
assert result == 3.0, f"Expected 3.0, got {result}"
print("✓ my_function basic")

assert my_function(0.0, 0.0) == 0.0, "Zero input should return 0"
print("✓ my_function zero input")

assert my_function(1.0, 1.0) > 0, "Result must be positive for positive inputs"
print("✓ my_function positivity")

print("\n✓ All [module name] tests passed")
```

> ↑ This should be a real code cell in your notebook.
